name: selenium
description_en: A browser automation framework and ecosystem.
readme_excerpt: Selenium Automates browsers. That's it! Contributing • Installing • Building • Developing • Testing • Documenting • Releasing Selenium is an umbrella project encapsulating a variety of tools and libraries enabling web browser automation. Selenium specifically provides an infrastructure for the W3C WebDriver specification — a platform and language-neutral coding interface compatible with all major web browsers.
